Big news: after fourteen months, our internal tool finally has a name.

It was called "the script" for nine months. Then "the new script." Then, briefly, "Greg's thing," which Greg objected to.

Today it is called Ledger. There was a vote. Ledger got four votes. "The script" got three.

Adoption is unchanged. The onboarding doc is unchanged. The one person who runs it every Monday is unchanged.

But the channel has an icon now, and I have never seen the team so proud of anything.

Thanks @gregvale for losing gracefully. Tomas Vale
